auth_lifecycle.unauthenticated_behavior: Navigate to login and clear protected back stack.
auth_lifecycle.forbidden_behavior: Render permission state without exposing protected data.
auth_lifecycle.logout_behavior: Revoke refresh token and clear secure local credentials.

state_management.server_state_strategy: Repository plus ViewModel observable server state.
state_management.cache_strategy: Explicit Room cache only for approved offline data.

forms_validation.client_validation_strategy: Local field validation mirrors contract constraints without redefining server rules.
forms_validation.api_validation_mapping: Map 422 fields and Problem Details to Compose error state.
forms_validation.conflict_mapping: Map 409 to explicit conflict resolution prompt.

observability.client_error_strategy: Attach request ID to sanitized crash/support context.
observability.pii_policy: Redact credentials and sensitive domain payloads.

accessibility.target: Android accessibility plus WCAG-equivalent interaction principles
accessibility.screen_reader_or_talkback: TalkBack semantics and meaningful content descriptions.
accessibility.focus_management: Predictable focus after navigation, validation and dialogs.

unit.strategy: Use-case, mapper and ViewModel unit tests.

component_or_ui.strategy: Compose UI tests for states and accessibility semantics.

e2e.strategy: Critical slice journeys on emulator/device against real test API.

offline.storage_strategy: Room stores only approved offline entities and explicit mutation queue.
offline.sync_conflict_policy: Server remains canonical; conflicts require documented merge/retry policy.
